description: This file defines a LagoLogger class for logging success events to Lago API, including environment validation, request preparation, and asynchronous/synchronous HTTP handling.

classes.name: LagoLogger
classes.description: A custom logger class for logging events to Lago API, handling environment validation, request construction, and both sync and async logging methods.

methods.name: get_utc_datetime
methods.description: Returns the current UTC datetime, using datetime.now(dt.UTC) if available, otherwise datetime.utcnow().

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the LagoLogger, validates environment variables, and sets up HTTP handlers.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Checks for required environment variables: LAGO_API_BASE, LAGO_API_KEY, LAGO_API_EVENT_CODE, and optional LAGO_API_CHARGE_BY.

methods.name: _common_logic
methods.description: Prepares the data payload for logging, including user identification, usage, cost, and other metadata.

methods.name: log_success_event
methods.description: Sends a success event log to Lago API synchronously.

methods.name: async_log_success_event
methods.description: Sends a success event log to Lago API asynchronously.
